pilot_pr.note: First paint-vm-ascii consumer; established the PaintGlyphRun-per-line pattern and the CliBuilder argv[0] convention gotcha (see lessons.md, 'C#' section).

known_gotchas: CliBuilder.Parser expects argv[0] to be a program name (C/Go convention); language's real args must be prepended with a placeholder, not passed raw.

LoadCow-equivalent file-path building from a user-supplied cowfile flag needs path-traversal / rooted-path-override protection (see cowsay.cs LoadCow for the pattern: GetFileName-only + reject rooted + verify containment).
paint-vm-ascii's glyph_run treats glyph_id as a literal Unicode code point (ASCII-backend-specific relaxation), not a font-internal glyph index -- see spec section 3.1.
Output must be verified byte-identical against an existing port (e.g. Go) for several flag combos, modulo paint-vm-ascii's spec-mandated trailing-blank-line trimming.
Gradle (java/kotlin): must redirect build output away from build/ (collides with BUILD file on case-insensitive filesystems) -- see lessons.md Gradle entries.
Swift on Windows needs the winget toolchain + vcvars setup -- see memory 'Swift on Windows setup'.
Lua rockspecs must pin immutable refs (tag/SHA), not moving branch tips -- see lessons.md Lua section.

build-tool's requiresExplicitPrereqs list (validator.go) is currently {python, typescript, perl} -- haskell is NOT in it, so cabal.project is the source of truth there (must list every transitive local package per lessons.md's Haskell section). For languages that ARE in the list, BUILD must textually reference every transitive local prerequisite's path (e.g. -I../../../packages/<lang>/<dep>/lib) -- use lib/import statements inside source files are invisible to the validator. Verify locally by building code/programs/go/build-tool and running -validate-build-files -detect-languages before pushing any language's cowsay PR; costly to discover only from a CI failure. See lessons.md 'Perl' section for the full writeup.

backlog.backend_work: delivered the full P2D02 contract (rect w/ stroke, line, glyph_run, group, clip, layer) to haskell/paint-vm-ascii, not just glyph_run -- same scope as perl-cowsay
backlog.notes: Found and fixed a real undefined-thunk bug in barcode-layout-1d (constructed PaintRect directly instead of via makeRect, missed by the initial grep-based consumer sweep -- only caught by actually running barcode-1d's test suite). Went through 5 rounds of /security-review; fixed unvalidated line/clip geometry, a product-only scene-size-cap bypass (zero-width/height scene), and an unsaturated Double->Int cell-coordinate conversion that could hit Int's minBound and defeat downstream clip clamping via integer wraparound (see lessons.md Haskell section, the "finite is not safely convertible to Int" lesson). Verified byte-identical to merged Perl port. Merged clean -- verified merge commit 89afea0efa on origin/main contains all security fixes (no stale-HEAD race).
